css: .hook-card { left:960px; top:250px; width:700px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:30px 36px 36px } .hook-title { display:block; font-size:44px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:22px } .hook-field { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; gap:20px; padding:16px 20px; margin-bottom:16px; border:2px solid var(--hair); border-radius:12px; font-size:28px } .hook-field span { color:var(--mute) } .hook-field i { font-style:normal; font-size:27px; white-space:nowrap } .hook-btn { margin-top:8px; padding:18px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--second); color:var(--ground); font-size:32px; font-weight:600; text-align:center } .hook-tag { left:1310px; top:730px } .hook-q { position:absolute; left:1700px; top:240px; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:120px; height:120px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); color:var(--ground); font-family:var(--display, serif); font-size:76px; line-height:120px; text-align:center }
